title: Amount spike
description: Transfer amount far above the customer's average daily spend (> 10×).

title: New beneficiary
description: The beneficiary account has never received a transfer from this customer.

title: Newly opened beneficiary account
description: Beneficiary account is less than 30 days old.

title: Screen sharing app active
description: A remote access app (e.g. AnyDesk) was detected during the transaction.

title: Copy-paste in beneficiary field
description: Beneficiary account number pasted repeatedly, suggesting a third party is directing the customer.

title: VPN / foreign IP
description: Session uses a VPN or an IP from a country other than the customer's home country.

title: Unusual hesitation
description: Pause before confirmation far above the customer's norm (> 3000 ms).

title: Abnormal typing pattern
description: Typing rhythm deviates from the customer's baseline by > 0.5.

title: Session too long
description: Session duration more than 5× the customer's baseline.

title: Rooted/jailbroken device
description: Device detected as rooted or jailbroken.

title: Unusual transaction hour
description: Transaction outside the customer's usual active hours.

title: Linked to mule account network
description: Beneficiary account shares a device with accounts recently flagged as fraud.
